description: Source code for an Android activity implementing a simple calculator interface with basic arithmetic operations and PIN-based unlocking.

classes.name: CalculatorActivity
classes.description: An Android activity providing a basic calculator interface with support for addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and percentage operations, including PIN-based unlocking.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and applies app-specific window settings.

methods.name: c
methods.description: Removes the last character from the display.

methods.name: number
methods.description: Handles number button presses, appends number to display, and checks for PIN entry.

methods.name: op
methods.description: Handles operator button presses, performs calculations, or percentage operations.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the current expression based on the last operator used.

methods.name: containsBinaryOperator
methods.description: Checks if a string contains any binary operator.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a double to string, removing trailing '.0' if applicable.
